scope: Discrete full-assembly poses. This is not a continuous swept-volume proof.
same_link_pairs: Excluded; evaluated by the separate static assembly check.
allowance_only_parts: Excluded because they are mass accounting volumes.
unmodeled_items: Actual plug dimensions and flexible cable routing

phone_samples.scope: Sampled phone_pan intersections with all other physical links
limitations: Angles between samples are not checked.
Stationary links retain the supplied poses throughout the check.
Parts sharing phone_pan are not compared with each other.

yaw_clamp_clearance.scope: Production coxa upper assembly versus its stationary yaw saddle and cap
yaw_clamp_clearance.equivalence_basis: All four interfaces instantiate the same production leg shapes. Each moving and fixed pair differs only by one shared rigid mounting transform, which preserves distance and intersection volume.
yaw_clamp_clearance.stationary_shape_coordinates: Already transformed to the assembly base frame by load_assembly
limitations: Only the four listed yaw positions and two listed stationary parts are checked.
The result does not establish continuous motion clearance.
Fastener heads, flexible cables, manufacturing tolerances and loaded deflection are excluded.
A gap below 0.5 mm is a warning and does not by itself count as a collision.

operating_yaw_clearance.scope: All four coxa upper assemblies at both configured operating yaw limits
operating_yaw_clearance.stationary_scope: Actual body deck and the moving leg's own stationary yaw saddle and cap
operating_yaw_clearance.stationary_shape_coordinates: Already in the assembly base frame; no repeated leg mount transform
limitations: Only the two operating limit positions are checked for each leg.
The result does not establish continuous motion clearance.
Fastener heads, cables, manufacturing tolerances and loaded deflection are excluded.
A gap below 1 mm raises a clearance warning without automatically failing collision status.

outside_operating_range_diagnostic_scope: The plus and minus 25 degree probes are outside the configured yaw operating range. Their results remain visible but do not qualify that range for operation.
